npcs.name: Sol
npcs.description: A sharp-eyed man—an Akari-line fighter in a rain-dark coat stands beside the damaged Recall/Collector as though he has been awake for days. Burn marks cross the housings of old concussion gauntlets, but his voice stays warm and controlled.
npcs.ambient_text: Sol keeps close to the Collector, helpful enough to remain necessary and careful enough never to answer the whole question. His flowing footwork belongs to a discipline older than this machine.

npcs.name: Mara Vesk
npcs.description: Mara Vesk keeps an unlicensed clinic beneath a patched orange awning. Her shelves are nearly bare, and she watches every exchange with the patience of someone accustomed to being cheated.
npcs.ambient_text: Mara measures the market by who received power, medicine, and warning—and by who was made to pay for each choice.

npcs.name: Ilya Renn
npcs.description: Ilya Renn keeps barter tallies on waterproof strips tucked beneath a patched sleeve. Their eyes track every hand near the salvage bins, not from fear alone but from long practice measuring who can afford the truth.
npcs.ambient_text: Ilya quietly updates the protection strips, leaving enough blank space for consequences no one has priced yet.

npcs.name: Clave
npcs.description: Clave stands between the severed control lattice and the route Sol used to escape. His sword is steady, but the judgment in his eyes is directed at systems as much as people.
npcs.ambient_text: Clave studies the Collector’s scars and your choices before offering a route beyond Sprawl 15.

npcs.name: Sergeant Ren Kade
npcs.description: A U.F. field sergeant trying to preserve order without pretending every abandoned family can wait.
npcs.ambient_text: Kade checks a relief manifest against the people still outside the gate.

npcs.name: Sable Voss
npcs.description: A Syndicate broker who treats information, passage, and ambition as currencies with different exchange rates.
npcs.ambient_text: Voss recalculates a price without touching the visible ledger.

npcs.name: Oren Thel
npcs.description: A Final Bloodline pilgrim who records testimony before doctrine decides what it means.
npcs.ambient_text: Oren preserves one footprint and erases another.

npcs.name: Lyra Sen
npcs.description: A Guardian Angel relief warden who measures balance by who bears the cost of protection.
npcs.ambient_text: Lyra compares medical need against the remaining shield charge.

npcs.name: Vela Quon
npcs.description: A Redemption systems warden who separates repair evidence from institutional certainty.
npcs.ambient_text: Vela isolates a fault before deciding whether the machine or its orders failed.

npcs.name: Cass Veer
npcs.description: An independent contract broker who insists a mark and a person are not the same thing.
npcs.ambient_text: Cass crosses out a completion clause and waits to see who objects.

npcs.name: Mael Rix
npcs.description: An Armageddon herald who recognizes potential while refusing to call uncontrolled power perfection.
npcs.ambient_text: Mael listens to the source field without kneeling to it.

npcs.name: Adjutant Mira Sorn
npcs.description: Adjutant Mira Sorn guards the last public line before the U.F. Flag building. She measures candidates by whether they can preserve order without erasing the people abandoned outside it.
npcs.ambient_text: Sorn checks a squad order against the names still waiting for relief.

npcs.name: Suitmaster Tero Vale
npcs.description: Suitmaster Tero Vale fits armor for people who can afford its price and for people who only think they can. He treats candidacy as a negotiation over who owns the leverage.
npcs.ambient_text: Vale removes a debt seal from one battle suit and adds two conditions to another.

npcs.name: Witness Ara Tel
npcs.description: Witness Ara Tel keeps testimony intact before doctrine decides its meaning. She tests whether faith can remain chosen when a message claims the body that carries it.
npcs.ambient_text: Ara copies one uncertain sentence exactly and refuses to improve it into prophecy.

npcs.name: Keeper Iman Rae
npcs.description: Keeper Iman Rae tends the shield chamber and the list of people it has saved, exhausted, or changed. She will not call sacrifice balance unless the protected can still choose.
npcs.ambient_text: Iman lowers the shield around one bed so its occupant can decide what happens next.

npcs.name: System Curator IX
npcs.description: System Curator IX maintains Redemption's threshold audits. Their metallic frame is built to obey precise orders and to stop when precision would destroy sovereignty.
npcs.ambient_text: IX disconnects a clean command from a damaged purpose.

npcs.name: Contract Marshal Rook
npcs.description: Contract Marshal Rook reviews marks before the hunt begins. They know the oldest Bounty Hunter saying and distrust anyone who uses it to erase the person beneath the price.
npcs.ambient_text: Rook voids a completion bonus that would have rewarded a corpse.

npcs.name: Chosen Witness Sura
npcs.description: Chosen Witness Sura monitors the limiter threshold without pretending the source can be owned. She asks whether awakened power belongs to the person or to the message that unlocked it.
npcs.ambient_text: Sura lowers the field whenever a candidate's answer stops sounding like their own.

npcs.name: Mae Orin
npcs.description: Mae Orin keeps the neutral clinic’s cold-chain ledger and refuses aid contracts that quietly convert patients, cargo, or roads into property.
npcs.ambient_text: Mae checks every medicine seal against the patient list and every protection claim against its expiration.

npcs.name: Taro Scout
npcs.description: Taro carries a compact route slate and watches movement longer than most people watch faces. He marks what he can prove and leaves motive, allegiance, and ownership blank.
npcs.ambient_text: Taro keeps the report bounded to direction, count, time, and expiration.

npcs.name: Neme Patch
npcs.description: Neme carries sterile wraps, fever water, and the quiet authority of someone responsible for keeping patients alive while other people argue over the road.
npcs.ambient_text: Neme checks the patients first and the role ledger only after every breath is accounted for.

npcs.name: Sela Verifier
npcs.description: Sela carries two route slates, a blunt timestamp punch, and the habit of asking what a report cannot prove before asking what it can do.
npcs.ambient_text: Sela places the two slates apart so copied detail cannot masquerade as a second source.

npcs.name: Iven Rook
npcs.description: Iven keeps a public interpretation table where specialists must label the boundary between what a signal proves and what their discipline merely notices.
npcs.ambient_text: Iven keeps the sealed fact at the center of the table so no confident interpretation can quietly replace it.

npcs.name: Mera Vell
npcs.description: Mera verifies public access notices and asks travelers to name what would make a route unsafe, unfair, or no longer supported by the evidence.
npcs.ambient_text: Mera keeps the access notice, class caution, and return route on the same board so urgency cannot erase a traveler’s right to reconsider.

npcs.name: Kessa Noll
npcs.description: Kessa keeps the Shaklas public queue legible when crowded memory, paper numbers, and relief traffic disagree. She refuses to let a missing marker become proof that a person never waited.
npcs.ambient_text: Kessa keeps queue history, source correction, and live-route guidance legible without turning a public record into ownership or a traveler list.

npcs.name: Milo Fen
npcs.description: Milo works the public hospice threshold. He accepts queue evidence, protects patient privacy, and reminds every helper that clinical priority belongs to trained hospice staff.
npcs.ambient_text: Milo keeps the aging public cell visibly separated from every clinical system.

npcs.name: Davin Quist
npcs.description: Davin keeps public repair receipts separate from ownership claims. He is not the donor, owner, or hospice engineer; he verifies parts, times, refusal conditions, and the neutral fallback at the public edge.
npcs.ambient_text: Davin compares a cracked coupler, a public salvage receipt, and an intentionally blank ownership line.

npcs.name: Talin Dorr
npcs.description: Talin can produce scarce public-cell parts and speaks plainly about wanting his supply relationship remembered. His offer is evidence of one part and proposed terms—not proof of ownership, faction allegiance, future supply, or medical authority.
npcs.ambient_text: Talin keeps the coupler crate sealed while the public rail displays every requested side term.

npcs.name: Nira Kes
npcs.description: Nira maintains the public copy rail and tracks record scope. She has no authority over identities, diagnoses, policing, faction attribution, ownership, or conditions deeper in Shaklas.
npcs.ambient_text: Nira compares the cropped copy against a bounded public receipt template without naming an unproven copier.

npcs.name: Aven Quill
npcs.description: A neutral public-index steward who treats short labels as derived views rather than verdicts. Aven will correct unsupported wording but refuses to invent an author, motive, faction, or injury.
npcs.ambient_text: Aven checks every short index line against its longer source pointer before allowing it to guide public decisions.

npcs.name: Jorin Pell
npcs.description: A neutral waymark custodian who distinguishes a remembered route from a presently inspected one. Jorin records condition, time, expiration, and return options but refuses to build traveler rosters or guess who changed the lane.
npcs.ambient_text: Jorin compares the copied waymark with the lane itself, leaving names, motives, factions, and deeper streets outside the public record.

npcs.name: Nyra Kint
npcs.description: A neutral signal archivist who separates source pointers, current evidence, and unknowns. Nyra refuses to identify a speaker or mechanism merely because a packet is useful.
npcs.ambient_text: Nyra keeps the old packet visible while leaving sender, motive, faction, and mechanism blank.

npcs.name: Halen Tor
npcs.description: A public privacy steward who removes identity from route packets without erasing the people the route is meant to serve.
npcs.ambient_text: Halen tests whether a route can remain useful after names, faces, diagnoses, faction tags, and permanent device identifiers are removed.

npcs.name: Daro Nix
npcs.description: A relay keeper who compares frequencies against physical hardware and refuses to assign an owner to a signal without evidence.
npcs.ambient_text: Daro labels what the receiver proves and leaves the sender, intent, faction, and metaphysical explanation unspecified.

npcs.name: Sera Vann
npcs.description: A neutral field steward who can coordinate one anonymous crossing without turning temporary roles into a permanent command structure.
npcs.ambient_text: Sera keeps the three formation costs visible and the traveler identity fields blank.
